feature_contract.goal: Preserve caller-requested D3D9 texture resource semantics for original vehicle-select and menu DDS replacements, allowing original native D3DX conversion or mip generation when the fast-copy path cannot honor them.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Fast path only returns matching caller format or D3DX sentinel, otherwise original D3DX creates requested texture.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Declared mip, autogen and unsupported mip requests
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exact existing mip copied; explicit auto/oversized mip count falls back to original loader; original UV, FFB and world unaffected.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: DX9Ex R84 package, host, source impact
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Portable smoke, mutation guard and exact GitHub full mandatory CI after branch integration; Quest3 remains untested.

feature_contract.scope_boundary: Original menu and Ferrari vehicle-selection replacement DDS upload only; preserve source DDS alpha intent, old UV paths, original game FFB/input, R84 render eye ownership and SkyGlow, and R26_SAFE fallback.
trace_stages: Original XST or external DDS replacement source enters TextureReplacement hook and native D3DXCreateTextureFromFileInMemoryEx request, including Width/Height/MipLevels/Format.
Independent R84 fast DDS loader resolves original DDS format, source row stride, packed mip payload and destination D3D9 texture allocation.

Original vehicle selector/menus consume the resulting texture and sprite UV on both R84 eye submissions; unsupported requested conversions revert to native D3DX call rather than silently returning another texture format.
subcomponents: Validate caller-requested mip level/generation semantics before fast texture allocation, allowing native D3DX to generate additional levels.
Validate caller-requested GPU texture format after raw DDS BGRA/24-bit conversion selection; preserve native fallback for mismatches without altering legitimate alpha/opaque texture interpretation.

validation_command: GitHub exact-SHA DX9Ex Active + Domain + HUD Inspector + Full Source Impact
notes: C2 material source commit 3f7641... and source regression wiring 7e59a4... are integrated. CI test negative guard count fixed under 770cdee8...; one exact SHA all gates requested via this bookkeeping/validation-input commit. This is not a new score or HMD PASS.

diagnosis.original_evidence: 2026-10-18 original game sprite map shows SELECTOR_CVT (31 DDS) and SUMO_FE_CVT (111 DDS), but source-only evidence cannot prove these specific textures exercise the unsupported request path.
source_trace: src/hooks_textures.cpp intercepts game D3DXCreateTextureFromFileInMemoryEx and tries copying DDS rows directly to D3D9 CreateTexture.
Fast loader previously ignored explicit Format and used parsed DDS format; RGBA/opaque and 24-bit conversions selected a different physical texture than requested by caller.
Fast loader clamped explicit mip requests to DDS count and replaced autogen zero with 1, violating requested texture semantics when native D3DX would convert or generate.
diagnosis.root_cause: Fast-path texture request/response contract violation: D3D9 actual output format could differ from the exact Format requested, while explicit mip generation or extra levels were discarded. This is a confirmed loader semantics defect, not yet a proven cause of Quest3 white sprites.
alternatives_rejected: Do not change DDS on-disk files, UV scaling transactions, selection artwork hashing, SkyGlow, R84 output eye layout or native input/FFB; preserve original D3DX fallback and declared RGBA alpha.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: A constexpr request admission helper rejects unsupported mip/Format requests before GPU allocation so native D3DX handles them, plus portable positive/negative C++ smoke and destructive mutation verification.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable smoke and mutation verifier authored; remote CI and matching Quest3 are pending.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The original texture resource is consumed by the existing per-eye R84 sprite pipeline unchanged; no promoted eye ownership or HMD assertion.

initial_failure.cause: New mandatory guarded DDS verifier changed required fail-closed count from seven to eight; repaired under same TASK_ID in 770cdee8... without suppressing a single negative guard.
